title: feat(nm2sready): neighbor-read of 1-in 2-out split at t+1 on two-axis opposite y-probes: reverse HOLD, face fails
science: Neighbor-read of the unsigned split on opposite y-probes: HOLD at A,B, fail at C (split HOLDs at C but no six-neighbour carries Axis(M)={e_2},Axis(O)={e_1,e_3}; the would-be match (0,3,0) never forms), fail at D (split fails). Repeats the joint-(M,O)-nonrecoverability discriminator: signed (M,O) equality fails at every y-probe.
